text: Psst. You there, with the face that says "bad ideas welcome".
They threw me in this cell because they think I'm a witch.
And true, I am a witch. But that's not the point.
Witches don't belong in jail. They belong outside jails, where they can be free to do witchy things.
If you'll help me achieve that, perhaps I can use those witchy things to help you out in return.

choices.text: *Ask what she needs.*
*No illegal prison break for you. Back away slowly.*

text: A guard is off duty somewhere in the bar.
How do I know that? Because I'm a witch. I know things.
He has my jail key. And you need to get it from him.
He is probably drunk, so this shouldn't be too difficult, but also not easy.
Don't forget, my freedom is on the line here. Good luck!
*Hic*
Hullooo. You look like... like... yeah.
Wait. Are you from my shift, your shift, or a *Hic* fish?
No, wait, don't answer. I can smell paperwork from here.
If you are paperwork, I surrender. If not, state your business-ish.

choices.text: *Act very serious and demand cooperation immediately.*
*Offer to buy him another drink.*
*Ask what he is doing off duty.*
[Jester 1] *Open with a ridiculous joke to get him laughing first.*
*Leave him to his drink.*

text: Hah! That's... that's a very good terrible joke. *Hic*
You have earned one official audience with Officer... hold on... Officer Me.
What do you want, comedian? Make it lawful-ish.

choices.text: *Try another joke instead of answering.*
*Say you forgot, but it was probably important.*
[Diplomat 1] *Frame this as official civic detention business.*
*Leave him to his drink.*

text: Detention business... that sounds official-ish. I respect-ish that.
What kind of detention business? Transfer forms? Inspection duty? *Hic* Speak.

choices.text: *Mention you need access to a specific jail cell.*
*Say it's classified. Need-to-know only.*
*Leave him to his drink.*

text: Cell access. Right. That requires a key. *Hic*
Rules say I cannot hand over duty equipment while off duty.
Counter-rules say I should avoid captain yelling. Very complex legal battlefield.

choices.text: *Ask politely one more time.*
*Back off and apologize.*
[Barbarian 1] *Threaten to make this a reportable incident.*
*Leave him to his drink.*

text: Right! Yes! Reportable is bad. Very bad. No reports.
You have command voice. I dislike it. I obey it.
Take the jail key. You were never here. I was never sober.
If anyone asks, this was a coordinated anti-paperwork maneuver.
Demanding tone detected. Rejected by tavern protocol.
No cooperation for storm voices. *Hic* Try being funny or useful.
Preferably funny. Useful people bring forms.
Tempting. But last time I accepted a drink, I promoted a barrel to captain.
Captain Barrel gave terrible orders, but morale was high.
No policy decisions after barrel incidents.
You forgot? Excellent. We are colleagues now.
Still no. Come back when your memory sobers up.
Or when mine does. Which is strategically unlikely.
No no, first answer, then joke. That's procedure. Maybe.
I enforce procedure when I can still see it.
Right now I can see two procedures and one of them is a lamp.
If you're that polite, you are probably plotting something.
No key. My suspicion outranks your manners.
Also manners make me nervous. *Hic*
Accepted. Very respectful. Still no key.
You may keep the apology though. Good quality apology.
One of the better apologies this week, actually.
I am performing undercover hydration. Very advanced guard work.
Also observing suspicious chairs. One of them moved.
I warned it. It moved again. Brave chair.
Classified? I love classified. Very mysterious.
Still no. Classified things need classified clearance. *Hic* Which I also don't have.
Oh! You. Still here. Or again. *Hic* Either way, you forgot the key. Take it. Before I lose it or promote it.
You were never here. I was never coherent. Good arrangement.
Wait. Who are you? My new guard, or my new favorite person?
Actually, do not answer. I am deciding you are my new favorite person.
Before I make my dramatic exit, anything you want to say?
You did it! You actually did it! I am out!
I know I can be a handful, but I promised to be useful, and I keep my promises.

12.name: Mozes
text: {INSTANT}*Explain a short version of your time traveling situation to defeat Ardor.*

choices.text: *Ask Ryiah to join you on your quest.* [BLUE](Join party)
*Tell her you don't need her help right now.*

14.name: Ryiah
text: You just broke a witch out of jail. Let's make it worth the trouble.

20.name: Ryiah
text: Fine, but don't forget that I owe you one. If you ever need my help, just ask.

9000.name: Ryiah
text: I cannot repay my debt to you if I cannot join you. Make some room in your party and then talk to me again.
You're dismissing a witch. Bold move.
I do hope you've thought about what you're giving up here.

choices.text: *Yes, you've thought about it. She can go.* [BLUE](Dismiss Ryiah)
*On reflection, no. Witches are useful.*

text: Fine. Don't come crying to me when things go sideways without magical backup.
All her equipment will also be gone once you bury her.

choices.text: *Yes, let the funeral continue.* [RED](Dismiss Ryiah)
*No, take precautions first.*

text: Oh, you came back. Ran into trouble without your witch, did you?

choices.text: *Yes. Without a witch, this party is just problems.* [BLUE](Join party)
*No, you just happened to walk past.*

text: Thought so. I still owe you one anyway. Let's go.
Sure you did. I'll be here when you're ready to stop lying to yourself.
I would love nothing more than to rejoin you. But even a witch can see there's no room. Come back when you've made space.
